# Course Found: Essentials of Global Health on Coursera

## Instructor
**Richard Skolnik**

**Title/Affiliation**: Former Lecturer, Department of Health Policy and Management, Yale School of Public Health and Lecturer in the Practice of Management, Yale School of Management (2012-2016)

## Bio Summary

Richard Skolnik has **more than 40 years of experience** in international development and Global Health. He is the author of the widely used textbook **"Global Health 101"** (third edition).

**Key Career Highlights:**
- Spent 25 years at the **World Bank**, retiring as the Director for Health and Education for the South Asia Region
- Worked on education in West Africa, and on health in the Middle East/North Africa, Latin America/Caribbean, West Africa, and South Asia
- His health work focused on: health systems financing and development, improving equity, maternal and child health, and the control of communicable diseases
- After leaving the World Bank, served as:
  - Vice President for International Programs at **PRB**
  - Director of the Center for Global Health at **The George Washington University** (taught undergraduate global health courses for 8 years)
  - Executive Director of the **Harvard PEPFAR** program for AIDS treatment in Botswana, Nigeria, and Tanzania (2 years)
- Served on the Technical Review Panel of the **Global Fund** and on several WHO Advisory and Working Groups
- Was deeply involved in the establishment of **STOP TB**
- More recently, worked on reviews of HIV financing in India, Cambodia, and Nigeria with the Results for Development Institute
- Serves on the editorial advisory body for the Third Edition of **Disease Control Priorities in the Developing World (DCP3)** and the third edition of **Millions Saved**
- For the last 5 years, was a Lecturer at Yale, where he taught introductory and advanced Global Health courses in Yale College and introductory Global Health courses in the School of Public Health and School of Management

**Education/Background**:
- From Dayton, Ohio, USA
- BA from **Yale University**
- MPA from the **Woodrow Wilson School of Princeton University**

## Additional Courses on Coursera

On Coursera, Richard Skolnik only offers **one course**:
- **Essentials of Global Health**

This is the only course listed under his instructor profile (https://www.coursera.org/instructor/richard-skolnik) in the "Courses - English" section.
